info.name: E-Commerce API
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for E-Commerce Back-End including Auth, Users, Categories, Subcategories, Brands, Products, Wishlist, Cart, Coupons, and Orders APIs.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Endpoints for authentication including signup, login, OTP verification, password reset, and refresh token.

item.name: Users
item.description: Endpoints for managing users. Admin operations require Bearer token authorization.

item.name: Categories
item.description: Endpoints for managing categories. Admin operations require Bearer token authorization.

item.name: Subcategories
item.description: Endpoints for managing subcategories. Admin operations require Bearer token authorization.

item.name: Brands
item.description: Endpoints for managing brands. Admin operations require Bearer token authorization.

item.name: Products
item.description: Endpoints for managing products. Admin operations require Bearer token authorization.

query.description: Field to sort by (createdAt | price | stock | ...)

formdata.value: Samsung flagship phone with AI features and 200MP camera.

item.name: Wishlist
item.description: Endpoints for managing user wishlist (add, remove, view, clear).

variable.description: Product ID to remove from wishlist

item.name: Cart
item.description: Endpoints for managing user shopping cart with stock-aware validation.

variable.description: Product ID to remove from cart

item.name: Coupons
item.description: Endpoints for managing discount coupons (Admin CRUD & validation).

item.name: Orders
item.description: Endpoints for creating and managing cash & Paymob orders, callbacks, cancellation, and refunds.
